ABOUT THE STUDIO

Small studio.
Direct process.

Sami Vibez Studio is a graphic design and video editing studio built around social-ready visuals — flyers, covers and branded graphics on one side, reels and promo cuts edited on CapCut and InShot on the other. You brief the project directly and work with the person actually making it, start to finish.

WHAT WE DO

Two crafts.
One studio.

Whether you need a still design or a moving one, it's built in-house — no outsourcing, no templates recycled from someone else's brand.

Graphic Design

Flyers, social posts, covers, logos and branding kits designed to hold attention in a crowded feed.

See design services →

Video Editing

Reels, TikToks and promo cuts — trimmed, transitioned and captioned on CapCut and InShot.

See editing services →

SERVICES

What we can
build for you

Every job starts with your brief — here's what falls under design, and what falls under edit.

01

Graphic Design

Still visuals built for social media, print, and everyday business use — matched to your brand's colours, fonts and tone.

  • Flyers & posters
  • Social media posts
  • Instagram & WhatsApp covers
  • Logo & brand marks
  • Business cards
  • Event & promo graphics
02

Video Editing

Raw footage turned into finished, publish-ready video — edited on CapCut and InShot for a clean, mobile-first feel.

  • Reels & TikTok edits
  • Transitions & effects
  • Captions & subtitles
  • Trimming & pacing
  • Intros & outros
  • Promo & ad cuts

HOW IT WORKS

From brief to delivery

01

Brief

You send what you need — the message, the footage or reference, and the deadline.

02

Draft

We put together a first version and send it over for your eyes.

03

Revisions

You tell us what to adjust — colours, pacing, text — and we refine it.

04

Delivery

Final file sent in the format you need, ready to post or print.
